answer.reason: Seth's birth as a replacement for Abel is stated in Genesis 4:25, which goes beyond the summary's relations, and the verses also give his death at 912 years.

clauses.english: was born to Adam and Eve and given by God in place of Abel, whom Cain slew
clauses.quote: God, said she, hath appointed me another seed instead of Abel

clauses.english: died at the age of nine hundred and twelve years
clauses.quote: all the days of Seth were nine hundred and twelve years: and he died

doubts: The birth clause may restate the summary's relation to Adam, Eve and Abel, but it says what happened at his birth; the editor may prefer to drop it.
GEN 4:26 says men began to call upon the name of the LORD in the days of Seth's son Enos; it is not stated as Seth's own deed, so it is left out.
